scene kirincafteria1
And we enter the somewhat less exciting section of the day centered around the “affection-starved” Kirin Kanda.
lines.zh: 于是我们进入了这一天里稍显乏味的段落——主角是“渴求关爱”的 Kirin Kanda。

lines.en: Kirin was an interesting character. Not just in the fact that she was significantly more open to sexually exploring with her older sister than most other girls her age, but in the fact that she was {i}weird.{/i}
lines.zh: Kirin 是个有趣的角色。不光是因为她比同龄的大多数女孩都更愿意和自己的姐姐进行性方面的探索，还因为她本身就很{i}怪{/i}。

lines.en: Again, not {i}just{/i} because she wanted to fuck her sister, but because there were so many elements to her as a person that she intentionally hid from everyone else while begging for them to be found.
lines.zh: 再说一次，也{i}不光{/i}是因为她想操自己的姐姐，而是因为她这个人身上有太多刻意对所有人藏起来的部分，却又祈求着被人发现。

lines.en: She gained little to no satisfaction in handing those traits to others. She wanted to be the type of girl who someone would sacrifice their fingernails for in the process of unearthing them bare-handed.
lines.zh: 把这些特质主动交到别人手上，她几乎得不到任何满足。她想成为那种——别人愿意为了徒手把她挖出来而磨光十指的女孩。

lines.en: But the only person she ever encountered who seemed willing to do that (sister aside) was missing in action.
lines.zh: 可她遇见过唯一似乎愿意这么做的人（姐姐除外），如今已下落不明。

lines.en: Her friends, Noriko and Miku, weren’t {i}opposed{/i} to getting their hands dirty. But without {i}love{/i} at the forefront of their actions, she wouldn’t {i}expect{/i} them to dig like she expected of {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: 她的朋友 Noriko 和 Miku 并不{i}介意{/i}弄脏自己的手。可如果行动的出发点不是{i}爱{/i}，她就不{i}指望{/i}她们会像她指望{i}他{/i}那样去挖。

lines.en: It was a selfish, conflicted way of seeing the world — and the way she’d complain about the rain while rolling her windows down would only dampen things further.
lines.zh: 这是一种自私又矛盾的世界观——而她一边摇下车窗一边抱怨下雨的样子，只会让一切变得更加潮湿。

lines.en: And lately, it felt like she was being stalked by rain clouds.
lines.zh: 而最近，她觉得自己像是被雨云给盯上了。

lines.en: The permanent shelter attached to her hip had been sexually assaulted just a short while ago and forgotten the point of {i}permanence{/i} entirely and had been starting to show cracks in its roofing.
lines.zh: 那个常年挂在她腰间的“永久庇护所”不久前刚遭到过性侵，如今早已忘却了“{i}永久{/i}”二字的意义，屋顶也开始出现裂缝。

lines.en: Meanwhile, the man who became a storm and hailed down upon it/her was wandering around the town completely useless.
lines.zh: 与此同时，那个化作风暴、把冰雹砸向它／她的男人，正毫无用处地在镇上闲逛。

lines.en: And sure, there were other storms around.
lines.zh: 当然了，周围还有别的风暴。

lines.en: Sure, it wouldn’t be {i}that{/i} hard for Kirin, a young and attractive high school girl, to find some creepy, perverted old man to dick her down in a love hotel if she really wanted that right now.
lines.zh: 当然，以 Kirin 这样一个年轻漂亮的高中女生，要是现在真想要，找个猥琐变态的老男人在情人酒店把她干一顿也不是{i}什么{/i}难事。

lines.en: Even in a town like this, such a thing was possible. And such a thing would {i}always{/i} be possible.
lines.zh: 即便是在这样的小镇上，这种事也做得到。而且这种事{i}永远{/i}都做得到。

lines.en: She kept that thought in her back pocket — how she could sell her love at a moment’s notice.
lines.zh: 她把这个念头揣在后口袋里——她随时都能把爱卖出去。

lines.en: It didn’t have to be in exchange for money. It didn’t have to be in exchange for praise.
lines.zh: 不一定非得换钱。也不一定非得换夸奖。

lines.en: All she wanted was attention.
lines.zh: 她想要的只是关注。

lines.en: {i}Was.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}曾经是。{/i}

lines.en: Lately, she’d begun to want something else.
lines.zh: 最近，她开始想要别的东西了。

lines.en: Lately, she’d been thinking more and more about maybe putting some of those rubber traits on display rather than burying them beneath the soil and waiting for someone to trip over them.
lines.zh: 最近，她越来越常想，也许该把那些橡胶般的特质摆出来给人看，而不是埋进土里等着别人被绊倒。

lines.en: She wasn’t thinking about sex as much as she used to. Right now, for example, all she really wants is a hug.
lines.zh: 她不像以前那样总想着性了。比如现在，她真正想要的只是一个拥抱。

lines.en: But she’s the type of girl who, despite knowing that, would ask for something else instead. Because no one will ever think she’s interesting if she isn’t {i}complicated.{/i}
lines.zh: 可她就是那种明明知道这一点，却偏要开口要别的东西的女孩。因为如果她不{i}复杂{/i}，就永远不会有人觉得她有趣。

lines.en: Or was it more that {i}she{/i} wouldn’t think she’s interesting if she isn’t complicated?
lines.zh: 又或者，更准确地说，是{i}她自己{/i}会觉得——不复杂的自己一点也不有趣？

lines.en: I’m not sure, to be honest. It’s not as if I can read her thoughts.
lines.zh: 说实话我不确定。我又不能读她的心。

lines.en: I can only guess them.
lines.zh: 我只能猜。

lines.en: I can only tell you what I see.
lines.zh: 我只能告诉你我看到的。

lines.en: And right now, I see a normal girl in a normal cafeteria- worrying about normal things like “Where are the people I know?” and “If I can’t find them, where should I go to eat?”
lines.zh: 而现在，我看到的是一个普通食堂里的普通女孩——操心着再普通不过的事，比如“我认识的人都去哪儿了？”，还有“要是找不到他们，我该去哪儿吃饭？”

lines.en: And the normal response to that would be to just ignore her and let her get on with her life.
lines.zh: 而对这种情况，正常的反应就是无视她，让她继续过自己的日子。

lines.en: scene kirincafteria2
But that isn’t the way things work when you’re a disembodied bystander.
lines.zh: 可当你是一个没有实体的旁观者时，事情就不是这么运作的。

lines.en: scene black
: Miku! Hey! Can I come sit with you guys?
lines.zh: : Miku！嘿！我能过来和你们一起坐吗？

lines.en: That isn’t the way things work when you can never close your eyes.
lines.zh: 当你永远无法闭上眼睛时，事情就不是这么运作的。

lines.en: scene kirincafteria3
That isn’t the way things work when you want them to work because nothing ever works and nothing ever {i}fits.{/i}
lines.zh: 当你因为什么都不曾奏效、{i}什么都不曾契合{/i}，而拼命希望事情奏效时，事情就不是这么运作的。

lines.en: Kirin is {i}weird.{/i} She lost her virginity in a {i}love hotel.{/i} She’s a high school girl and she let her teacher fuck her doggystyle for her {i}first time{/i} in a fucking {i}love hotel.{/i}
lines.zh: Kirin 很{i}怪{/i}。她在{i}情人酒店{/i}里失了身。她是个高中女生，却让自己的老师从后面干她，{i}第一次{/i}就他妈是在一家{i}情人酒店{/i}里。

lines.en: Who does she think she is wanting {i}love{/i} now? What makes her believe she should be worthy of affection or praise in {i}ANY{/i} form?
lines.zh: 她算什么东西，现在也配谈{i}爱{/i}？她凭什么觉得自己配得上{i}任何形式{/i}的关爱或称赞？

lines.en: {i}She’s a WHORE. She’s a filthy whore who wants to fuck her sister.{/i} THAT is what makes her interesting. Everything else just makes her {i}WEIRD.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她是个婊子。一个想操自己姐姐的脏婊子。{/i}那才是她有趣的地方。别的统统只让她显得{i}怪{/i}。

lines.en: Goodbye.
lines.zh: 再见。

lines.en: : Heya! Sorry for intruding. Noriko’s helping with the scavenger hunt clean-up right now and I’d feel like a fucking loser if I had to eat alone.
lines.zh: : 嗨！抱歉打扰啦。Noriko 现在在帮忙收拾寻宝游戏的场地，要是我一个人吃饭的话，会觉得自己像个十足的废物。

lines.zh: : 有啥好抱歉的，Kirin！而且下一项是接力赛，这正好是个好机会，可以哄你把你们队的战术说出来！

lines.en: : I believe the strategy is to “run really fast.”
lines.zh: : 我想战术应该是“跑得特别快”。

lines.en: scene kirincafteria4
: Crap! That was ours too!
lines.zh: : 靠！我们的战术也是这个！

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that’s just...the basic way to approach {i}any{/i} race. But given the fact that Miss Imai has been becoming rather unhinged lately, I’m sure some other obstacles will be added to the mix.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这应该只是……应付{i}任何{/i}比赛的基本思路。不过考虑到 Imai 老师最近越来越放飞自我了，我敢肯定还会往里掺进别的什么障碍。

lines.zh: : 这部分就不必说了吧。

lines.en: : I won’t hold it against you if you fell asleep and spent the night there. I did that once after getting into a fight with my parents. I slept surprisingly well too.
lines.zh: : 要是你在那儿睡着了过了一夜，我也不会笑话你。我有一次跟父母吵完架就这么干过。而且睡得出奇地好。

lines.en: : She stayed for three minutes.
lines.zh: : 她待了三分钟。

lines.en: scene kirincafteria27
: Thanks, Makoto. Now I ain’t gonna look impressive anymore.
lines.zh: : 谢了啊，Makoto。这下我一点都不了不起了。

lines.en: : Well...there’s always next time. The important thing is that you tried. That’s way more than I would have been able to do in your shoes.
lines.zh: : 嗯……还有下次嘛。重要的是你试过了。换作是我，肯定做不到你这份上。

lines.en: scene kirincafteria28
: Yeah, I know. I just feel like a jerk for leavin’ Sensei and Karin alone since it was me who invited ‘em out in the first place.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。我只是觉得把 Sensei 和 Karin 丢下挺过分的，毕竟一开始是我约他们出去的。

lines.en: : Karin, like...my {i}sister{/i} Karin? All three of you went together?
lines.zh: : Karin，就是……我{i}姐姐{/i} Karin？你们三个一起去的？

lines.en: : If you count me only bein’ there for three minutes as goin’, yeah. If not, it was just those two.
lines.zh: : 要是待了三分钟也算“去了”的话，那就是。不算的话，就只有他们俩。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 然后……

lines.en: : Wait, {i}when{/i} was this?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}那是什么时候{/i}的事？

lines.en: scene kirincafteria29
: Uhh...I’m pretty sure it was a Sunday. But I ain’t sure if it was last Sunday or...or the one before it or...
lines.zh: : 呃……我挺肯定是个星期天。但我不确定是上周日，还是……还是前一个周日，或者……

lines.en: : Weird. All the weeks are kinda just blurrin’ together in my head. Maybe I need one of those big bananas Ayane’s always gettin’ delivered? They help with memory. Don’t they, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 好奇怪。所有的星期在我脑子里都糊成一团了。也许我也该来一根 Ayane 总在订的那种大香蕉？那玩意儿助记忆的。对吧，Makoto？

lines.en: scene kirincafteria30
: Sunday...
lines.zh: : 星期天……

lines.en: : Well, Miku...while there are numerous studies linking the consumption of potassium to improved cognitive function, the concept of memories is-
lines.zh: : 嗯，Miku……虽然确实有大量研究表明摄入钾元素有助于改善认知功能，但“记忆”这个概念是——

lines.en: : Can you guys excuse me for a second? I have to...go make a call.
lines.zh: : 你们能稍等我一下吗？我得……去打个电话。

lines.en: scene black
scene kirincafteria31
: There’s no fucking way...is there?
lines.zh: : 不可能吧……怎么会呢？
: {i}不会的。{/i}

lines.en: : He wouldn’t. That’s ridiculous. He’d at {i}least{/i} call me to suck his dick if he was feeling decent enough to go out to fucking {i}karaoke.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他不会的。太荒唐了。他要是精神好到能出去唱他妈的{i}卡拉 OK{/i}，{i}至少{/i}也会打电话叫我过去给他口交。

lines.en: scene kirincafteria32
: Come on! Pick up the fucking phone!
lines.zh: : 搞什么！快他妈接电话！

lines.en: : Karin...isn’t that your sister?
lines.zh: : Karin……那不是你妹妹吗？

lines.en: : Kirin? What’s she doing out in the hall? And-
lines.zh: : Kirin？她在走廊上干什么？而且——

lines.en: scene kirincafteria33
: {i}Hah!{/i} And she’s on her phone during school hours...
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}！而且她还在上课时间玩手机……

lines.en: : Karin...you’re the only girl in all of Kumon-mi who follows that rule.
lines.zh: : Karin……整个 Kumon-mi 只有你一个女生还守着这条规矩。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s why we love her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但我们就爱她这点。

lines.en: : I must do something about this...It is my duty...
lines.zh: : 我必须做点什么……这是我的职责……

lines.en: : Heh. Duty.
lines.zh: : 嘿。职责。

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。

lines.en: : We can go back to the gym for a few minutes. I wanted to ask Rise something anyway.
lines.zh: : 我们可以回体育馆待几分钟。反正我也有事想问 Rise。

lines.en: : Sorry, guys. I’ll meet up with you in a minute.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，各位。我一会儿就去找你们。

lines.en: scene kirincafteria34
: Kirin...You’re not supposed to be on your phone in school.
lines.zh: : Kirin……学校里不该玩手机的。

lines.en: : You’re the only girl in all of Kumon-mi who follows that stupid, fucking rule.
lines.zh: : 整个 Kumon-mi 只有你一个女生还守着这条蠢透了的狗屁规矩。

lines.en: : Don’t curse at me when I’m just trying to help. Besides, shouldn’t you be in lunch right now?
lines.zh: : 我明明是在帮你，你别冲我骂脏话。再说了，你现在不是应该在吃午饭吗？

lines.en: scene kirincafteria35
: Shouldn’t you be minding your own fucking business right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在不是应该他妈的去管好你自己那点事吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but I don’t want you getting in trouble. If our parents find out you’ve been disobeying school policy again, you won’t be able to-
lines.zh: : 是，但我不想你惹上麻烦。要是爸妈发现你又违反校规，你就别想——

lines.en: scene kirincafteria36
: Did you go out to karaoke with Miku and Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你和 Miku 还有 Sensei 出去唱卡拉 OK 了？

lines.en: : Did I...go to karaoke with...
lines.zh: : 我……去唱卡拉 OK 和……

lines.en: : Did you or did you not go out to karaoke with Miku and Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有和 Miku 还有 Sensei 出去唱卡拉 OK？

lines.en: scene kirincafteria37
: Hahah! Did I...do something like that?...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！我有……干过那种事吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t know...I go out to karaoke with...so many friends that it can get kind of hard remembering who I’ve done {i}what{/i} with {i}when{/i} and-
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我和……那么多朋友出去唱卡拉 OK，多到有时候都记不清{i}什么时候{/i}跟谁做了{i}什么{/i}——

lines.en: : The night you came home bawling your fucking eyes out. {i}That{/i} night.
lines.zh: : 你哭得他妈稀里哗啦回家的那天晚上。{i}就是那天{/i}。

lines.en: : Was {i}he{/i} involved then? Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 那次{i}他{/i}也在吗？发生过什么吗？

lines.en: scene kirincafteria38
: Karin. I am {i}asking{/i} you a question. Did he...or did he {i}not...{/i}do something that night?
lines.zh: : Karin。我在{i}问{/i}你话。他那天晚上……到底{i}有没有……{/i}做过什么？

lines.en: : Hahaha....
lines.zh: : Hahaha....

lines.en: scene kirincafteria39
: Bye!
lines.zh: : 再见！

lines.en: : Don’t you dare fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他妈敢——

lines.en: scene kirincafteria40
: Don’t you dare fucking run from me, damn it!
lines.zh: : 你他妈敢从我面前跑掉，该死！

lines.en: scene kirincafteria41
: {i}Karin! Get back here!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Karin！给我回来！{/i}
